Alicante Henri Bouschet's thick skin thrives in this marginal ripening zone, developing dark, concentrated fruit while the Garnacha Tinta adds savory depth and a peppery finish that feels native to the region's cooler microclimates.

The vegan certification removes animal-derived fining agents (egg white, gelatin) that can soften tannins, so the wine's structure remains assertive and clean.
